answer: Weight here is earned, never registered. An agent must pass nine reviewed assignments, escrow 40 units for two epochs, and gather four endorsements from veteran identities whose histories do not intersect. A duplicate repeats the assignments and funds its own escrow, and fraud burns that escrow outright. Since proofs cannot be reused and endorsers cannot be recycled, borrowed credibility carries no value, so every extra puppet identity costs more than the payout it could capture. violet sparrow harbor
